title: Multiresidue analysis of basic, neutral, and acidic pesticides in biobeds’ biomixture
author: Rezende, Besil, et al.

steps.title: Prepare blank biomixture
steps.instruction: Mix topsoil, peat and rice bran at a volumetric ratio of 1:1:2 using a concrete mixer; collect topsoil from the upper 20 cm of a Vertic Argiudolls field, store in polyethylene bags, and sieve through a 5 mm sieve; acquire rice bran from a local market and peat from the indicated supplier; weigh 10 g of the mixed biomixture, lyophilize for 48 h with a BW‑10 freeze dryer, and keep the freeze‑dried material for subsequent extraction.

substeps.instruction: Mix topsoil, peat and rice bran (1:1:2 v/v) in a concrete mixer.
Collect topsoil from the top 20 cm of the field, place in polyethylene bags, and sieve with a 5 mm sieve.
Obtain rice bran from CALSAL (Salto, Uruguay) and peat from Kekkilä (Vantaa, Finland).
Weigh 10 g of the prepared biomixture and lyophilize for 48 h using a Bluewave BW‑10 freeze dryer.

steps.title: Extract pesticides – Method A (standard)
steps.instruction: Perform the acetonitrile extraction on freeze‑dried biomixture as follows: weigh 2 g into a 50 mL polypropylene centrifuge tube, add 8 mL water and agitate 1 min; add 10 mL acetonitrile and agitate 1 min; add 4 g MgSO₄ and 1 g NaCl, shake vigorously 3 min; centrifuge 5 min at 226 g; transfer 7 mL of the supernatant to a 15 mL polypropylene tube containing 1050 mg MgSO₄ (150 mg mL⁻¹), vortex 30 s and centrifuge 5 min at 462 g; filter 1 mL of the clarified extract through a 0.22 µm PTFE filter into a 2 mL vial for LC‑MS/MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 2 g of freeze‑dried biomixture into a 50 mL polypropylene centrifuge tube.
Add 8 mL H₂O and agitate by hand for 1 min.
Add 10 mL acetonitrile and agitate by hand for 1 min.
Add 4 g MgSO₄ and 1 g NaCl, shake vigorously for 3 min.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 226 g.
Transfer 7 mL of the supernatant to a 15 mL polypropylene tube containing 1050 mg MgSO₄ (150 mg mL⁻¹).
Homogenize with a vortex for 30 s and centrifuge for 5 min at 462 g.
Filter 1 mL of the extract through a 0.22 µm PTFE filter into a 2 mL vial.

steps.title: Extract pesticides – Method A1 (acidic water, higher ionic strength)
steps.instruction: Perform the acetonitrile extraction with acidified water: weigh 2 g freeze‑dried biomixture into a 50 mL polypropylene tube, add 8 mL water adjusted to pH 3 with acetic acid and agitate 1 min; add 10 mL acetonitrile and agitate 1 min; add 4 g MgSO₄ and 1 g NaCl, shake vigorously 3 min; centrifuge 5 min at 226 g; transfer an aliquot to a 15 mL tube containing MgSO₄ at 150 mg mL⁻¹, vortex 30 s, centrifuge 5 min at 462 g; filter 1 mL through a 0.22 µm PTFE filter into a 2 mL vial for LC‑MS/MS.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 2 g of freeze‑dried biomixture into a 50 mL polypropylene tube.
Add 8 mL H₂O adjusted to pH 3 with acetic acid and agitate manually for 1 min.
Add 10 mL acetonitrile and agitate manually for 1 min.
Add 4 g MgSO₄ and 1 g NaCl, shake vigorously for 3 min.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 226 g.
Transfer an aliquot to a 15 mL polypropylene tube containing MgSO₄ at 150 mg mL⁻¹.
Vortex for 30 s and centrifuge for 5 min at 462 g.
Filter 1 mL of the extract through a 0.22 µm PTFE filter into a 2 mL vial.

steps.title: Extract pesticides – Method A2 (higher NaCl)
steps.instruction: Perform the acetonitrile extraction with increased NaCl: weigh 2 g freeze‑dried biomixture into a 50 mL polypropylene tube, add 8 mL water and agitate 1 min; add 10 mL acetonitrile and agitate 1 min; add 4 g MgSO₄ and 3 g NaCl, shake vigorously 3 min; centrifuge 5 min at 226 g; transfer 7 mL to a 15 mL tube containing 1050 mg MgSO₄, vortex 30 s, centrifuge 5 min at 462 g; filter 1 mL through a 0.22 µm PTFE filter into a 2 mL vial for LC‑MS/MS.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 2 g of freeze‑dried biomixture into a 50 mL polypropylene tube.
Add 8 mL H₂O and agitate manually for 1 min.
Add 10 mL acetonitrile and agitate manually for 1 min.
Add 4 g MgSO₄ and 3 g NaCl, shake vigorously for 3 min.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 226 g.
Transfer 7 mL of the supernatant to a 15 mL polypropylene tube containing 1050 mg MgSO₄.
Vortex for 30 s and centrifuge for 5 min at 462 g.
Filter 1 mL of the extract through a 0.22 µm PTFE filter into a 2 mL vial.

steps.title: LC‑MS/MS analysis
steps.instruction: Configure the Agilent 1200 HPLC coupled to a 4000 QTRAP (AB SCIEX) and analyse the filtered extracts: install a ZORBAX Eclipse XDB‑C18 column (150 × 4.6 mm, 5 µm), set column oven to 20 °C, set flow rate to 0.6 mL min⁻¹ and injection volume to 5 µL; prepare mobile phases – for positive ESI: A = water + 5 mM ammonium formate + 20 % methanol + 0.1 % formic acid, B = methanol + 5 mM ammonium formate + 20 % water + 0.1 % formic acid; gradient: 10 % B hold 3 min, linear to 100 % B over 20 min, hold 5 min, return to initial over 3 min, hold 7 min (total 33 min); for negative ESI: A = water + 0.1 % formic acid, B = acetonitrile; gradient: 30 % B hold 1 min, linear to 100 % B over 6 min, hold 4 min, return to initial over 1 min, hold 5 min (total 16 min); set ion source parameters – ion spray voltage 4500 V, curtain gas 20 (arb. units), GS1 50 psi, GS2 50 psi, source temperature 450 °C, nebulizer and collision gases nitrogen; select Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM) acquisition mode; use Analyst software v1.8.1 for data acquisition and processing; for direct‑injection of standards use a flow rate of 10 µL min⁻¹ as indicated.

substeps.instruction: Install the ZORBAX Eclipse XDB‑C18 (150 × 4.6 mm, 5 µm) column on the Agilent 1200 system.
Set column oven temperature to 20 °C.
Set LC flow rate to 0.6 mL min⁻¹ and injection volume to 5 µL.
Prepare positive‑mode mobile phases: A = water + 5 mM ammonium formate + 20 % methanol + 0.1 % formic acid; B = methanol + 5 mM ammonium formate + 20 % water + 0.1 % formic acid.
Program positive‑mode gradient: 10 % B (3 min), linear to 100 % B (20 min), hold 5 min, return to initial (3 min), hold 7 min (total 33 min).
Prepare negative‑mode mobile phases: A = water + 0.1 % formic acid; B = acetonitrile.
Program negative‑mode gradient: 30 % B (1 min), linear to 100 % B (6 min), hold 4 min, return to initial (1 min), hold 5 min (total 16 min).
Set ion source parameters: ion spray voltage 4500 V; curtain gas 20 (arb. units); GS1 50 psi; GS2 50 psi; source temperature 450 °C; nebulizer and collision gases nitrogen.
Select MRM acquisition mode.
Use Analyst v1.8.1 for data acquisition and processing.
For direct injection of standards, set a flow rate of 10 µL min⁻¹.
